title: cdn_headers
description: Event: the CDN-facing headers a donut write or refresh put on the response, read back after they are final so the log carries the effect, not the request. `headers` holds the literal name => value pairs of every CDN-facing header this package's setters manage that is present on the response (CDN-Cache-Control, Surrogate-Control, Akamai-Cache-Control, Surrogate-Key, Edge-Cache-Tag) — including the bound setter's default when no sMaxAge was requested. No lifetime header present means the response gives the CDN no lifetime, which is how an un-cacheable donut page (putDonut) stays off the CDN. `surrogateKeys` is the split key list from whichever key header is present (Surrogate-Key, or Edge-Cache-Tag under Akamai): the list an invalidation's tags must reach to drop this response at the edge. A state-served hit replays the stored headers unchanged and emits no new event.
